tests: release-verify rejects a wait or poll bound above 86400 seconds, by flag and by environment

consumesExternalOutput.program: npm cache add, npm view and npm install against the public registry, spawned by scripts/release-verify.sh
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Both captures are real output from npm 11.18.0 on node v26.6.0, 2026-09-23, against registry.npmjs.org with a fresh cache per command; the tests' stub npm replays their exit codes and stderr rather than typed strings. rule (f)'s shell arm binds scripts/release-verify.sh because it is a *.sh that spawns npm and node. TWO MEMBERS (Sonnet CR-002): member 0 raises the ceiling, so 86401 is accepted; member 1 keeps the ceiling and drops the length check that runs before the comparison, so a 19-digit value reaches an integer comparison bash cannot make.
